Apostolic Canons

Glossary

Apostolic Canons

Apostolical Canons

A collection of 85 disciplinary canons printed in Percival’s appendix, distinct from the canons issued at a single named council. The traditional title does not establish that the surviving compilation was personally written by the Twelve; the editor separately discusses its development.
